name: Pumbah's Tacos & Burgers
tagline: Big burgers and tacos from a family food truck on West 1st in Dumas.
about: Pumbah's Tacos & Burgers is a family-owned food truck at 201 W 1st St in Dumas.
Call in your order and stop by to pick it up. Reviewers mention big portions, the Pumbah burger, the quesadilla and the salsa.
